# `ambience` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "ambience" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/ambience/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique zone id, e.g. slice-gallery. |
| `notes` | string | required | What the zone is for and the state of its assets. |
| `bed` | object | — | The looping bed under the zone; crossfades with the next zone’s over 2 s. |
| `bed.cue` | string | required | Looping non-positional cue. |
| `bed.gainDb` | number -60–12 | `0` | Trim in dB on top of the cue and the ambience bus. |
| `oneShots` | list of object | `[]` | Randomised positional one-shots around the listener while in the zone. |
| `oneShots[].cue` | string | required | Positional cue on the ambience bus, e.g. amb-cave-drip. |
| `oneShots[].minIntervalS` | number > 0 | required | Shortest gap between plays, seconds. |
| `oneShots[].maxIntervalS` | number > 0 | required | Longest gap between plays, seconds. |
| `oneShots[].minRadius` | number ≥ 0 | required | Nearest spawn distance from the listener, m. |
| `oneShots[].maxRadius` | number > 0 | required | Farthest spawn distance from the listener, m. |
| `oneShots[].height` | number | `0` | Height of the spawn above the listener, m. |
| `oneShots[].gainDb` | number -60–12 | `0` | Trim in dB on top of the cue and the ambience bus. |
